title: Request a synthetic library card
summary: Open the synthetic request form, enter the requested details, and submit the request. The guide ends on the confirmation page.

steps.title: Begin the request
steps.instruction: Select Begin synthetic request to open the form.

steps.title: Enter the request label
steps.instruction: Enter the requested value in the Synthetic request label field.

steps.title: Finish the request
steps.instruction: Continue to the Synthetic request complete page to finish.
